findings.affected_requirement: T015/T016 exact case binding, plan fixed-corpus/result/receipt set equality, and release-evidence-contract aggregate recomputation
findings.evidence: A schema-valid passed envelope can change one Case Receipt caseId and its nested Stream Attempt caseId together to a foreign unique ID while retaining twelve receipts, corpusResultCount 12, and matching fingerprints. Current validation proves local receipt consistency but never parses or obtains the fixed-corpus and result-row ID sets. Existing foreign/mismatched vectors mutate only the receipt ID and are rejected by local receipt/attempt mismatch rather than promised corpus/result binding.
findings.correction_outcome: Add a schema-valid coordinated-mutation RED changing both Case Receipt and nested Stream Attempt identity while counts and fingerprints remain consistent. Give semantic validation access to hash-verified fixed-corpus and result artifacts and require their parsed ID sets to equal the Case Receipt set exactly, without implementing the deferred Tier 3 runner, streaming transport, Track B/C, or Story 12.4 changes.

summary: REVISE. The immutable Track A matrix passes 114/114 and the Scan/UI/security/persistence/resume/DI/database/no-migration boundary is acceptable, but QR-TA-001 remains High because coordinated foreign case identities are not bound to parsed fixed-corpus/result artifact contents.
